text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to hone our skills 
begins. 
Even while traveling to the camp facility, 
Daring Tact stayed busy.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I have finished filling out 
the TV program questionnaire.
choice_data_list: Thanks, I'll look it over.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Next up is... recording our comments at 
the camp lodge. 
Until then, I suppose I should rest?
choice_data_list: Yeah, get plenty of rest.
Yeah, get plenty of rest.

text_block_list.text:
Having become a Double Tiara horsegirl, 
Daring Tact had been receiving more than 
twice 
as many interview and media appearance 
requests as before.

I handle as much of it as I can 
to avoid placing too much burden on her, 
but...
choice_data_list: Are you doing alright? Not too tired?
Are you doing alright? Not too tired?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I am fine. 
There is certainly a lot to do, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is such a blessing that so many people 
take an interest in me. 
I want to respond to their support as best 
I can!
choice_data_list: Attagirl, Tact!
That's great, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... Daring Tact. 
Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Um, we're from another class, so you 
probably 
don't know who we are, but... 
Well, we just really wanted to tell you!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on the Double Tiara! 
You were so amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
When you won, I clapped so hard 
at the screen! 
Hehe, not like you could hear me or 
anything!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
That's how much energy you gave us...! 
It really gave me the courage 
to do my best too...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff A
text_block_list.text:
It's not just Hidaka. 
I'm sure so many people... are seeing hope 
in you!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Um, so... 
Is it okay if we keep looking forward 
to your Triple Tiara, Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course! 
Please look forward to it.

After arriving safely at the lodge, 
just as I was about to discuss 
the schedule starting today—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
I want to do wilderness survival!
choice_data_list: Wilderness... survival?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I will participate in the 
training camp. 
However, I wish to set up my base of 
living 
out in nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In order to ensure I achieve the Triple 
Tiara, 
I want to sharpen myself even further.
choice_data_list:
And you think survival training is the way 
to do that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Relying on myself and living out in 
the mountains day after day... 
granted me the ability to adapt to any 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I believe it will grant me the strength to 
seize the final crown this time as well. 
...Would that not be alright?

When it comes to survival, she's 
practically a pro. 
If we get permission from the academy and 
I accompany her at all times, 
there shouldn't be any major issues. But—
choice_data_list: (Can I... actually keep up?)
(Can I... actually keep up?)

text_block_list.text:
A wave of anxiety washed over me for a 
moment, but... upon reflection, this was 
an opportunity. With the Triple Tiara 
looming, the weak part of me that felt 
overwhelmed by the pressure—

Could I become stronger by braving this 
survival regimen together? 
Just like her...
choice_data_list: ...Alright, let's go do some surviving!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there's someone else I would 
love to invite...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow, a survival training camp?! 
Now doesn't that sound thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So... if it's alright with you, 
would you like to join us, Daring Heart?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I thought having you with us would help me 
hone myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Hmm... let me see.
choice_data_list: (Hm? Did she just look at me?)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, but I think I'll pass this time! 
I already promised Kraft and the others 
that we'd have the ultimate summer 
together.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You'll be just fine, Tact. 
You have your Trainer right beside you, 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Work together and conquer it! 
Just the two of you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—That's true, isn't it? 
I took it for granted that Trainer would 
come along, but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When you think about it, it's a precious 
experience. 
Maybe I'll gain something entirely new 
from it...
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Together— 
let's begin the ultimate survival training 
camp!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... did you two 
just say "survival"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Win Marilyn! 
Yes, we're planning to incorporate it into 
our camp.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's incredible. To think aiming for 
the Triple Tiara 
requires getting into character to that 
extent...
choice_data_list: I think this is just a Tact thing...

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. Tact simply knows 
the best way to make herself shine.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
I won't let myself fall behind either! 
Will you... watch the results of all my 
hard work at the Shuka Sho?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! 
I want to face you as a stronger version 
of myself too, Win Marilyn.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...When we watched the Shuka Sho together, 
I ended up feeling utterly overwhelmed, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You were all fired up instead, weren't 
you? 
I thought it was truly remarkable.

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text:
! 
Back then—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I know how strong you are too. 
Let's both do our very best!

text_block_list.name: Win Marilyn
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

And so, after securing permission from the 
academy, 
we scouted the area around the lodging for 
a suitable survival site—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is our survival campsite... 
Not a single building in sight, and zero 
man-made conveniences.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mountains at our back and the ocean before 
our eyes—this is perfection!
choice_data_list: I set it up closer to the sea this time.
I set it up closer to the sea this time.

text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact is well accustomed to 
mountains. 
In that case, centering our training 
around the sea should place a heavier load 
on her.

I had heard nobody ever comes out to this 
spot. 
By day, we'd conduct standard camp 
training, and out here, we'd practice 
survival—
choice_data_list:
Honestly, I think I'll be relying on you 
quite a lot.

Honestly, I think I'll be relying on you 
quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
Please, rely on me all you like.
choice_data_list:
Still, I'm going to put in just as much 
effort right alongside you!

Still, I'm going to put in just as much 
effort right alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
...Right!
choice_data_list: Let's get stronger, Tact!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
—I look forward to our summer camp, 
Trainer!
